issues.description: The template Lecture.java declares two public fields (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) while the UML in the problem statement and the solution implementation define all lecture attributes as private. This visibility mismatch in the template can confuse students: they may try to add private fields with the same names (causing duplicate-definition compile errors) or be unsure whether to keep or change the existing public fields. The template also omits the other attributes required by the UML (numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), increasing the likelihood of incorrect or conflicting implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture.java to match the UML and solution visibility: remove or change the existing public field declarations and declare all required attributes as private (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This prevents duplicate-name issues and makes the intended implementation clear to students.
